problems: The red driving wheels come up through the running board: their tops (z 0.50) sit above the board's top (z 0.49), so red patches show on the deck. The deck has to clear the wheels.
The driving wheels read small for a card that names 'large red wheels'. Most of each wheel is hidden under the board, and they are well smaller than the boiler.
The front wheel axle (top at z 0.26) hangs below the frame (bottom at z 0.29), so the front wheel pair is not attached to anything. The tender wheel axles have the same gap under the tender frame.
The cylinders float out at x 0.27-0.45 with no saddle joining them to the frame, which only reaches x 0.18. They also cut into the front driving wheel.
The drawbar (y 0.85-0.95) does not reach the locomotive frame, which ends at y 0.83, so the tender is not coupled.
